Package com.nexuslink.ui.files

Interface FileTransfer

All Known Implementing Classes:
AzureBlobFileSystem, GcsFileSystem, GridFsFileSystem, S3FileSystem
public interface FileTransfer
Moves bytes between the local disk and a remote service (SFTP/FTP) for the two-pane browser. Implemented by each protocol view over its own client (e.g. SFTP via SftpService).

    • upload

      default void upload(Path localFile, String remoteDir, String destName, LongConsumer progress) throws Exception
      Uploads localFile into remoteDir but landing under destName rather than the source's own file name — used by the "rename on conflict" resolution to keep both files. The default ignores destName (natural name); real file systems override to honour it.

    • supportsResume

      default boolean supportsResume()
      Whether this transport can append to a partially transferred file, letting an interrupted transfer pick up mid-file rather than starting over. Transports that say true must implement both uploadFrom(java.nio.file.Path, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, long, java.util.function.LongConsumer) and downloadFrom(com.nexuslink.ui.files.FileItem, java.nio.file.Path, java.lang.String, long, java.util.function.LongConsumer). See ResumePlan for when it is safe.

    • uploadFrom

      default void uploadFrom(Path localFile, String remoteDir, String destName, long offset, LongConsumer progress) throws Exception
      Uploads localFile from byte offset onward, appending to the partial file already at remoteDir/destName. An offset of 0 is an ordinary whole-file upload.

      progress reports the file's total bytes present (i.e. offset plus what this call has sent), not just this call's contribution, so percentages and throttling stay correct across a resume. The default throws, so a transport must opt in via supportsResume().

      Throws:
      Exception

    • downloadFrom

      default void downloadFrom(FileItem remoteFile, Path localDir, String destName, long offset, LongConsumer progress) throws Exception
      Downloads remoteFile from byte offset onward, appending to the partial file at localDir/destName. Progress semantics match uploadFrom(java.nio.file.Path, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, long, java.util.function.LongConsumer).
      Throws:
      Exception
